heroHeadline: CDC Case Count Quietly Climbs to 19,595 as AP Ties Outbreak to Years of Declining FDA Foreign Inspections
heroSubtitle: CDC's cyclosporiasis case-data page updated Sept 8 to 19,595 lab-confirmed cases and 1,043 hospitalizations season-wide — up from 18,445/990 on Sept 1 — even though the agency said Sept 4 it was reducing update frequency; the narrower Taylor Farms/Taco Bell multistate outbreak page stays frozen at 11,458 illnesses across 20 states since Aug 27. A Sept 8 Associated Press investigation finds FDA foreign food-site inspections have fallen nearly 35% since 2019, dropping to 1,140 in fiscal 2025 against a statutory target of over 19,000. Separately, Taylor Farms has consolidated its response into a Cyclospora information hub citing 2,000 zero-positive samples, and food-safety attorney Bill Marler notes FDA's newly finalized fresh-cut produce guidance is non-binding.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
